title: statusline r4 A11y: install-offer prompt has no non-interactive path
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 4. Lens: accessibility (validator: ux). Owner: SO session. Defect: the new interactive confirmation specifies disclosure exhaustively but nothing says how a TTY-less caller, an agent-driven init (this is an agent-first toolkit), or a motor-disability operator answers it — the offer becomes a blocking gate; no fixture drives the prompt without a live answer. Citations verified: contract:159, :184. Proposed: deferred-candidate, foldable (non-interactive init presents no prompt and makes no write; prints the manual invocation and the interactive re-run path; never a hang).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree (deferred folded per standing pattern). Non-interactive conduct contracted: no prompt, no write, prints the offer's existence, the manual invocation, and the interactive path — never hangs, never writes unconfirmed; criterion drives it against the statusLine-absent fixture. Revision: Install bullet + Install behaviors criterion.
